sources.snippet: Overview Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO is a merge of accelerators, VAE, and CLIP designed for fast image editing and text-to-image generation using the Qwen Image Edit architecture. Built and maintained by Phr00t, this model runs in ComfyUI and uses FP8 precision to reduce memory requirements while maintaining quality. sources.snippet: Rapid inference: Typically 4 steps (Lightning LoRA style), CFG=1, very fast. Image-to-Image editing with strong prompt adherence (v23 tuned for this). Text-to-Image support as well. NSFW friendly in appropriate versions. Merged VAE + CLIP + accelerators for easy one-click use (especially in ComfyUI).
